title: Threshold rescaling and floor accounting for the same mixed-cubic family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-free language in proof.md and family.py, with fixed STRENGTH=2^850 and delta=2^(-850). Exact delayed-constant root guards define zero at failed shapes. Otherwise every actual input bit is payload for the balanced-tree challenge-response construction. Its half-rate component is the mixed relative-trace cubic Tr_(K/L)(x^3+nu*x^7) over explicit power-of-two quadratic-tower fields; small design fields are deterministically searched. All choices are uniform, no field-polynomial prefix or advice is supplied, and the fixed polynomial runtime exponent is enormous.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[{"coefficient":{"denominator":"9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999","numerator":"1"},"log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"-999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"-999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999"}}]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the same single fixed total certificate-free language in P specified by family.py, with construction strength 2^850, put D=10^256-1, A=10^255-1 and eta=1/D. For every sufficiently large integer actual length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^eta/(D*(log2 N)^A*(log2 log2 N)^A). The threshold rescaling and floor remove any additive rounding loss. The same complete guarantee implies joint projection (4,1). All constants are fixed; no subpolynomial-remainder endpoint or varying-strength family is asserted.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact B2 identities and potential rows; ordinary and delayed-degree integer roots; general irreducibility, tower fields, design intersections, code linearity and subset enumeration; mixed relative-trace identities, exceptional-subfield nonvanishing, quadratic formulas and polar ranks; actual constant-zero guard evaluations. Finite predicates only, not execution of the nontrivial asymptotic family or certification of universal claims.
